repos.description: Self-evolving Context Database for AI Agents. Unify Agent Memory, Knowledge RAG and Skills.
repos.summary_zh: OpenViking是专为AI Agent设计的开源上下文数据库，创新性地采用文件系统范式统一管理记忆、资源与技能，解决碎片化问题。核心亮点包括：L0/L1/L2分层加载大幅降低token成本；目录递归检索结合语义搜索提升精度；检索轨迹可视化打破RAG黑盒；自动会话管理实现上下文自演进。
repos.summary_en: OpenViking is an open-source context database designed for AI Agents. It unifies memory, resources, and skills via a filesystem paradigm. Key features include tiered loading (L0/L1/L2) to reduce token consumption, directory-recursive retrieval for improved precision, visualized retrieval trajectories for full observability, and automatic session management enabling self-evolving, adaptive context.

repos.description: 📑 PageIndex: Document Index for Vectorless, Reasoning-based RAG
repos.summary_zh: PageIndex 是一个创新的向量无关、基于推理的 RAG 系统，专为专业长文档设计。它摒弃传统向量数据库和分块策略，通过构建层次化树形索引并模拟人类专家推理过程，实现上下文感知的智能检索。核心优势在于将相似度搜索升级为相关性推理，支持视觉基础 OCR 自由的工作流，并提供 MCP 集成，显著提升复杂文档的检索准确性与深度理解能力。
repos.summary_en: PageIndex is a vectorless, reasoning-based RAG framework designed for professional long documents. It replaces traditional vector databases and chunking with a hierarchical tree index, enabling LLMs to perform agentic, human-like retrieval through tree search reasoning. By prioritizing relevance over similarity, it supports OCR-free vision-based workflows and MCP integration, delivering superior accuracy for domain-intensive document analysis.

repos.description: Memory and context engine + app that is extremely fast, scalable, and can be run fully locally. The Memory API for the AI era.
repos.summary_zh: supermemory 是一个高性能、可扩展的AI记忆引擎，定位为用户的'第二大脑'。核心亮点在于支持MCP协议，可无缝集成Claude、Cursor等AI工具，实现智能记忆检索与对话。支持URL、PDF、文本等多格式内容导入，提供浏览器插件和Raycast扩展。采用API优先设计，既可作为个人知识管理平台，也能通过开发者控制台集成到企业工作流，支持自托管部署。
repos.summary_en: Supermemory is a high-performance, scalable AI memory engine positioned as your 'second brain.' Its core strength lies in MCP protocol integration, enabling seamless connectivity with AI tools like Claude and Cursor for intelligent memory retrieval and chat. It supports multi-format content import (URLs, PDFs, text) via browser extensions and Raycast. API-first design allows both personal knowledge management and enterprise workflow integration through its developer console, with self-hosting options available.

repos.description: 1,324-exercise fitness dataset — animation GIFs, 180×180 thumbnails, muscle-group & equipment data, and step-by-step instructions in 6 languages. The exercise data layer behind the LogPress app.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供1,324个健身动作的综合数据集，每个动作包含动画GIF、180×180缩略图、身体部位/器械/目标肌肉/肌群元数据，以及9种语言的分步指导说明。作为LogPress AI健身追踪应用的底层数据，支持健身应用开发、运动识别推荐的机器学习项目、健康研究及教育原型。亮点包括结构化JSON文件与验证模式、纯客户端交互浏览器（搜索筛选多语言详情）、开发者工具（多数据库SQL生成、API示例及LLM后端提示），媒体按Gym visual许可使用。
repos.summary_en: This repository delivers a ready-to-use dataset of 1,324 fitness exercises, each with animated GIFs, 180×180 thumbnails, metadata on body parts, equipment, targets and muscle groups, plus step-by-step instructions in 9 languages. It powers the LogPress AI-assisted workout tracker and supports fitness app development, ML exercise recognition/recommendation, health research, and education. Highlights include validated JSON with schema, client-side interactive browser with search/filters/multilingual details, and developer tools offering DB SQL generators, API examples across languages, and LLM prompts for backend generation. Media licensed from Gym visual.

repos.description: A full-featured, hackable Next.js AI chatbot built by Vercel
repos.summary_zh: Vercel开源的全功能AI聊天机器人模板，基于Next.js 14 App Router与React Server Components构建。集成Vercel AI SDK提供统一LLM API，默认支持xAI，可无缝切换OpenAI等提供商。采用shadcn/ui组件与Tailwind CSS样式，数据持久化依托Neon Serverless Postgres和Vercel Blob存储，内置Auth.js认证。支持一键部署至Vercel，为开发者提供开箱即用的可扩展聊天应用解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Vercel's open-source, full-featured AI chatbot template built with Next.js 14 App Router and React Server Components. Powered by Vercel AI SDK for unified LLM API access, defaulting to xAI while supporting seamless integration with OpenAI, Anthropic, and other providers. Features shadcn/ui components styled with Tailwind CSS, data persistence via Neon Serverless Postgres and Vercel Blob storage, and Auth.js authentication. Enables developers to quickly build and deploy hackable chatbot applications with one-click Vercel deployment.

repos.description: A lightweight, lightning-fast, in-process vector database
repos.summary_zh: Zvec 是阿里巴巴开源的轻量级进程内向量数据库，基于内部验证的 Proxima 搜索引擎构建。它提供毫秒级十亿向量相似性检索，支持密集/稀疏向量与混合查询，无需独立服务即可直接嵌入应用。适用于推荐系统、语义搜索等场景，具备生产级性能、低延迟与极简部署的核心优势。
repos.summary_en: Zvec is a lightweight, open-source in-process vector database developed by Alibaba, powered by the battle-tested Proxima search engine. It provides millisecond-level similarity search for billions of vectors, natively supporting dense and sparse embeddings with hybrid search combining semantic and structured filters. As an embeddable library, it requires no standalone server and runs directly within applications. Ideal for recommendation systems, semantic search, and edge AI scenarios, Zvec delivers production-grade performance, low latency, and effortless deployment across platforms from cloud servers to edge devices.

repos.description: The all-in-one, open-source backend platform for agentic coding. InsForge gives your coding agent database, auth, storage, compute, hosting, and AI gateway to ship full-stack apps end-to-end.
repos.summary_zh: InsForge 是专为 AI 编程代理打造的**开源一体化后端平台**，提供数据库、认证、存储、计算、托管及 AI 网关等全栈能力。通过 **MCP Server** 和 **CLI+Skills** 双模式，让 AI 代理能像资深后端工程师一样操作资源，实现应用开发、部署、调试的端到端自动化，极大提升 AI 编程效率与质量。
repos.summary_en: InsForge is an **open-source, all-in-one backend platform** purpose-built for agentic coding. It equips AI coding agents with comprehensive capabilities including database, authentication, storage, compute, hosting, and AI gateway. Through dual interfaces of **MCP Server** (self-hosted/cloud) and **CLI+Skills** (cloud-only), agents can operate backend resources like professional engineers, enabling **end-to-end automation** of full-stack application development, deployment, and debugging, dramatically improving AI coding efficiency and quality.

repos.description: 🏋 Modern open-source fitness coaching platform. Create workout plans, track progress, and access a comprehensive exercise database.
repos.summary_zh: Workout.cool 是一个现代开源健身教练平台，支持创建个性化训练计划、追踪健身进度，并提供包含详细说明与视频演示的全面运动数据库。基于 Next.js 16、Prisma ORM 和 Feature-Sliced Design 架构构建，具备 Docker 自托管、多语言支持及 Stripe 集成，旨在为健身开源社区提供可靠、可维护的自托管解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Workout.cool is a modern open-source fitness coaching platform for creating personalized workout plans, tracking progress, and accessing a comprehensive exercise database with detailed instructions and video demos. Built on Next.js 16, Prisma ORM, and Feature-Sliced Design architecture, it supports Docker self-hosting, i18n, and Stripe integration, reviving reliable tools for the fitness open-source community.

repos.description: VPS 融合怪服务器测评脚本 —— 更推荐使用无环境依赖的 Go 版本：https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs VPS Fusion Monster Server Test Script — we now recommend the Go version (zero external dependencies): https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs
repos.summary_zh: 融合怪(VPS Fusion Monster)是功能全面的服务器测评脚本，提供自动化硬件与网络基准测试。Go重构版本彻底解耦环境依赖，支持非root用户运行，兼容多架构(amd64/arm64等)与主流Linux发行版。核心功能涵盖CPU/内存/磁盘性能测试、三网回程路由追踪、多节点网速测试及15数据库IP质量检测。支持交互菜单与参数化无值守模式，可自定义Geekbench版本、磁盘测试工具等，专为开发者与运维人员设计的极致轻量高效测评方案。
repos.summary_en: Fusion Monster (ECS) is a comprehensive server testing script for VPS benchmarking. The Go-based implementation eliminates environment dependencies, supports non-root execution, and maintains compatibility across multiple architectures (amd64/arm64/i386/arm) and Linux distributions. Core capabilities include CPU/memory/disk performance evaluation, triple-network routing analysis, multi-node speed tests, and IP quality validation via 15 databases. Features both interactive menu and headless parameter-driven modes, with customizable options for Geekbench versions, disk test utilities, and China-specific network endpoints, designed for developers and sysadmins.

repos.description: 🔥 基于大模型和 RAG 的智能问数系统，对话式数据分析神器。Text-to-SQL Generation via LLMs using RAG.
repos.summary_zh: SQLBot 是基于大语言模型与 RAG 的智能问数系统，实现自然语言到 SQL 的精准转换。支持对话式数据分析（ChatBI），提供开箱即用的部署体验，内置工作空间隔离与细粒度权限管控。通过术语库与示例校准持续优化，支持 Web 嵌入、MCP 调用等多种集成方式，快速赋能业务系统智能查询能力。
repos.summary_en: SQLBot is an LLM-powered intelligent data query system leveraging RAG for accurate Text-to-SQL conversion. It enables conversational data analysis (ChatBI) with out-of-the-box deployment, featuring workspace isolation and fine-grained access control. The system continuously improves through custom terminology and SQL examples, offering flexible integration via Web embedding and MCP calls to rapidly empower business applications with natural language query capabilities.

repos.description: Lossless Claw — LCM (Lossless Context Management) plugin for OpenClaw
repos.summary_zh: Lossless Claw 是 OpenClaw 的无损上下文管理插件，基于 LCM 论文实现。它通过 DAG 结构摘要系统解决 AI 代理长对话的 token 限制问题，将所有消息持久化到 SQLite 数据库，并使用 LLM 动态生成多层次摘要，确保对话历史完整可查。提供搜索工具让代理随时召回细节，实现永不遗忘的智能体体验。
repos.summary_en: Lossless Claw is a Lossless Context Management (LCM) plugin for OpenClaw that solves AI agents' context window limitations through innovative DAG-based summarization. Instead of truncating old messages, it persists every message in SQLite and creates hierarchical LLM-generated summaries, forming a directed acyclic graph that preserves all original details. The system dynamically assembles context by combining recent messages with relevant summaries, ensuring no information is ever lost. With built-in tools like lcm_grep and lcm_expand, agents can instantly search and retrieve any historical detail, delivering a seamless never-forget conversational experience while staying within model token constraints.

repos.description: Open-source GEO content engineering and multi-site distribution platform with AI quality inspection, illustrated admin help, hosted sites, browser-assisted publishing, and signed updates.
repos.summary_zh: GEOFlow 是开源的 GEO 内容工程与多站点分发系统，通过 AI 生成、RAG 知识库、素材管理和任务自动化，实现可信内容资产的全链路管理。支持多模型调用、智能审核、SEO 优化和静态页面分发，适用于大规模内容生产与多渠道发布场景。基于 Laravel 和 pgvector，提供 Docker 一键部署方案。
repos.summary_en: GEOFlow is an open-source GEO content engineering and multi-site distribution system that orchestrates AI generation, RAG knowledge bases, material management, and task automation into a sustainable workflow. It enables teams to transform trusted resources into manageable, publishable, and trackable content assets across multiple channels. Key features include multi-model AI integration, intelligent review, SEO optimization, static page generation, and analytics. Built on Laravel with PostgreSQL and pgvector, it offers Docker Compose deployment for scalable content operations.

repos.description: GDM Science Skills to speed up agentic scientific workflows with better grounding and higher token efficiency. Integrate insights from AlphaGenome, AFDB, UniProt and 30+ other databases and tools.
repos.summary_zh: google-deepmind/science-skills 是 Google DeepMind 推出的科学技能集合，旨在加速 AI 智能体的科学工作流。它集成 AlphaGenome、AFDB、UniProt 等 30+ 数据库和工具，提供结构化指令、脚本资源，提升事实 grounding 和 token 效率。技能 spanning 基因组学、结构生物学、化学信息学及文献检索等领域，与 Google Antigravity 深度集成，助力高效科研任务。
repos.summary_en: The google-deepmind/science-skills repo delivers a bundle of agent skills from Google DeepMind to enhance scientific workflows for AI agents. It integrates over 30 databases and tools like AlphaGenome, AFDB, and UniProt, offering structured instructions and scripts for better grounding and token efficiency. Covering genomics, structural biology, cheminformatics, and literature search, these skills are optimized for the Google Antigravity platform, improving reliability and enabling efficient scientific automation.

repos.description: Open Source Clones of Popular Games
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个开源游戏克隆数据库网站，聚合各类经典游戏的开源复刻版本信息。采用YAML管理游戏数据，Python构建静态站点，支持Docker一键部署。开发者可通过PR或Issue提交游戏条目，GitHub Actions实现自动化构建部署。为游戏开发者提供学习参考和项目发现平台。
repos.summary_en: This is an open-source game clones database website that aggregates information about open-source reimplementations of popular classic games. It uses YAML files for structured game data management, Python for static site generation, and supports Docker deployment. Developers can contribute new game entries via pull requests or GitHub issues, with GitHub Actions automating the build and deployment workflow. The platform serves as a valuable resource for game developers to discover open-source projects, reference implementations, and learn from existing game clones.

repos.description: Identify email addresses or domains names that belong to colleges or universities. Help automate the process of approving or rejecting academic discounts.
repos.summary_zh: JetBrains/swot 仓库维护全球教育机构邮箱域名列表，用于自动验证学生和教师身份并授予 JetBrains 工具免费许可证。核心价值是简化学术折扣审批流程，支持全球高校用户获取专业开发工具。应用场景覆盖学生免费授权与教育机构验证。技术亮点包括层级目录结构存储域名、子域名自动包含、滥用域名黑名单及严格准入规则，确保数据准确可靠。
repos.summary_en: JetBrains/swot maintains a hierarchical list of academic email domains to verify eligibility and grant free JetBrains tool licenses to students and teachers worldwide. Core value lies in automating academic discount approvals for global educational users. Application scenarios include student/teacher license verification. Technical highlights feature structured directory storage, subdomain inclusion, abused domain blacklist, and strict inclusion criteria for authenticity.

repos.description: 🚀 Full-stack Next.js 15 + Cloudflare Workers template with D1 database, R2 storage, Better Auth, and Server Actions. Production-ready with automated CI/CD and generous free tiers.
repos.summary_zh: 该模板深度融合 Next.js 15 与 Cloudflare Workers 边缘计算平台，提供生产级全栈解决方案。核心亮点包括 D1 分布式 SQLite 数据库、R2 对象存储、Better Auth 认证体系及 Server Actions 数据交互，通过 Drizzle ORM 实现端到端类型安全。内置 GitHub Actions 自动化流水线与预览部署，充分利用 Cloudflare 免费层实现低成本启动，支持从 MVP 到企业级应用的无缝扩展。
repos.summary_en: This production-ready template integrates Next.js 15 with Cloudflare Workers edge computing, delivering a full-stack solution featuring D1 distributed SQLite database, R2 object storage, Better Auth authentication, and Server Actions. With end-to-end TypeScript via Drizzle ORM, automated CI/CD via GitHub Actions, and preview deployments, it leverages Cloudflare's generous free tier for cost-effective MVP development while scaling seamlessly to enterprise applications.

repos.description: An out‑of‑the‑box Next.js + Cloudflare full‑stack starter integrating Edge Runtime, D1 database, R2 storage, KV cache, Analytics Engine hooks, and a complete CI/CD pipeline.一个开箱即用的 Next.js + Cloudflare 全栈项目模板，集成 Edge Runtime、D1 数据库、R2 存储和完整的 CI/CD 流程。
repos.summary_zh: 一个开箱即用的Next.js + Cloudflare全栈模板，专为边缘计算场景打造。基于vinext实现4倍构建加速和57%包体积缩减，深度集成D1数据库、R2存储、KV缓存和Analytics Engine。内置better-auth认证、next-intl国际化、Vitest测试和完整CI/CD流水线，提供生产级环境变量验证、结构化日志和自动化迁移验证。适用于需要高性能、低成本、全球部署的现代化Web应用开发。
repos.summary_en: Production-ready Next.js + Cloudflare full-stack starter for edge computing. Leverages vinext for 4x faster builds and 57% smaller bundles, deeply integrating D1 database, R2 storage, KV cache, and Analytics Engine. Features better-auth authentication, next-intl i18n, Vitest testing, and complete CI/CD pipeline with production-grade environment validation, structured logging, and automated migration verification. Ideal for high-performance, low-cost, globally-deployed modern web applications.

repos.description: Graph database native to the cloud. Embedded, multi-tenant, built on object storage.
repos.summary_zh: NamiDB是一款基于对象存储的云原生图数据库引擎。它将节点和边以列式文件形式存于S3等桶中，桶为唯一真相源，支持Cypher查询。引擎支持嵌入式（如DuckDB）、HTTP服务器或云托管三种模式，利用S3条件写入实现多租户零协调架构。专为AI智能体构建知识图谱设计，成本可归零、备份简单，填补Kùzu归档后的空白。
repos.summary_en: NamiDB is a cloud-native graph database built on object storage. It persists nodes and edges as columnar files in S3 buckets, with the bucket as the single source of truth. It supports Cypher queries and runs embedded like DuckDB, as an HTTP server, or in hosted cloud using the same engine. S3 conditional writes enable multi-tenancy without consensus layers. Ideal for AI agents needing knowledge graphs, it offers zero-cost scaling and simple S3 backups. It fills the gap after Kùzu's archiving.

repos.summary_zh: Openmind是一个自托管数字commonplace book。保存链接、引用、图片和想法，通过颜色、词语或语义找回。Postgres+Go部署，pgvector语义搜索，颜色提取。功能有阅读器、Drift、Desk、Lenses、RSS。AI可选，JSON导出。
repos.summary_en: Openmind is a self-hosted digital commonplace book for saving links, quotes, images, and thoughts, rediscovering them via colors, words, or semantic vibes. It offers instant capture, Postgres with pgvector for full-text and semantic search, color palette extraction, distraction-free reader, Drift for resurfacing forgotten items, Desk for pinning, Lenses for saved queries, and RSS feed integration. Deployed as a single Go binary with Docker, AI is optional through adapters. Emphasizes user data control with JSON exports. Perfect for personal knowledge management without backlogs.
